port.type: ideal vertical lumped line; no pin/coax connector/aperture/deembedding
port.reference_plane: the lumped port itself (U and I integrated over z 0..h at the feed point); no plane shift, no beta, no de-embedding: the probe inductance belongs to the antenna

budget_before_solve.RAM_basis: P01_OPENEMS_002 RSS 758256 KiB / 4841937 nodal cells = 0.156602 KiB/cell, x2.0 margin
budget_before_solve.conservative_basis: 2048 B/cell, unmeasured; reference only, not used in the abort rule
budget_before_solve.time_basis: nodal cells * steps / 53 Mcell/s (measured in P01_OPENEMS_002); steps scale with 1/timestep from P01_OPENEMS_002 (10368 steps, record 3.930e-09 s); assumes the same physical record (resonator Q may lengthen it); capped by NrTS
budget_before_solve.abort_rule: do not launch if RAM (measured basis x2) > 8 GiB or estimated time > 1800 s

nf2ff_overhead.basis: UNMEASURED assumption: each DFT accumulation (1 field component, 1 frequency, 1 face node) costs 0.167 of a full Yee cell update; face nodes x 6 components x 11 frequencies; dump RAM = complex<float> x face nodes x 6 x n_freq (the x2 margin applies); NF2FF post-processing (CalcNF2FF, 4 phi x 37 theta x n_freq) is separate and not part of the engine time

excitation.nominal_range_rule: spectrum exp(-2.25 (f - f0)^2 / fc^2) (openEMS excitation.cpp CalcGaussianPulse/MaxFreq): -20 dB at f0 +- 1.0116 fc
excitation.NrTS_EndCriteria_note: pulse length scales as 1/fc (fc 1 GHz: 2.87 ns; 2.5 GHz: 1.15 ns) and is far below the 30000-step cap; the energy criterion is relative to the peak energy, so it is unchanged; the step estimate in budget_before_solve keeps the 006 record length (conservative: a shorter pulse cannot lengthen the ring-down). Higher f_max only raises the probe sampling rate. Cells: xy <= 0.5 mm (lambda_FR4/27 at 10.5 GHz), air z <= 0.8 mm (lambda0/36). PML_8 and the NF2FF box (17.5 mm) are less effective at 5.5 GHz (box 0.32 lambda): outside-band content is for the port only; NF2FF frequencies stay in the channel.

far_field.name: nf2ff
far_field.model: openEMS.CreateNF2FFBox(frequency=[...]) (openEMS.pyx lines 464-521; frequency kw selects frequency-domain E/H dumps, nf2ff.py lines 65-80, dump_type 10/11, single-sided DFT weights Common/processfields_fd.cpp lines 103-106, the same single-sided convention as the port probes DFT_time2freq utilities.py lines 27-41, so Prad and port powers are directly comparable as in Tutorials/Helical_Antenna.py line 179 and RadarUWBTutorial.py line 182). Box = the default derived from the PML_8 boundaries: faces on mesh line index 9 / -10 (one cell inside the PML region, in air, outside the board and the substrate; no conductor crosses the box because the SMA/port is inside the board). CalcNF2FF(sim_path, freq, theta, phi, radius=1 m, center in METRES, read_cached=False): E_theta/E_phi include the factor exp(-jkr)/r at r = 1 m (nf2ff_calc.cpp lines 503-513), P_rad = |E|^2/(2 Z0) in W/m^2, Prad = net Poynting flux through the box (nf2ff_calc.cpp line 414, independent of the sampled angles), Dmax = max over the SAMPLED directions only (line 525). Quantities derived here: D = 4 pi r^2 P_rad / Prad; gain (IEEE, excludes mismatch) = 4 pi r^2 P_rad / P_acc; realised gain = 4 pi r^2 P_rad / P_inc (the formula of RadarUWBTutorial.py line 182, Dmax*Prad/P_inc); radiation efficiency = Prad / P_acc with P_acc = 0.5 Re(U I*) at the port reference plane (Helical_Antenna.py line 179; MSL edge ports since round 7: measurement plane, fixed 50 ohm, so the ~4.9 mm of feed line before it is outside the efficiency); total efficiency = Prad / P_inc. Prad contains radiation only; conductor, dielectric and any feed-stub loss are in P_acc - Prad. Vertical lumped ports (probe feed, round 12): P_inc and P_acc come from openEMS Port.CalcPort at the port (reference = the 50 ohm port resistance, no plane shift), so the probe is part of the antenna; same NF2FF box, same single-sided DFT convention.
far_field.box_distance_to_board_edge_in_lambda_at_: lambda at 5.5 GHz = 54.5 mm; the box is in the near field of the board below ~5.5 GHz
far_field.cuts: phi=0/180 (xz plane) and phi=90/270 (yz plane), theta 0..180 every 5 deg
far_field.dmax_caveat: Dmax from openEMS is the maximum over the sampled directions only; D(theta,phi) here uses Prad
far_field.radiated_group_delay: ENABLED_DIAGNOSTIC (11 points): Radiated group delay (only with 11 points): H(f) = E_far(theta=0, phi=0, f) exp(+j k r) / a_inc(f), with a_inc the incident-wave voltage at the reference plane of the port (same plane as S11: launch plane for MSL edge ports, the lumped port itself for the vertical probe port: no plane shift, no beta), r = 1 m, k = 2 pi f / c0. E_theta and E_phi of the phi=0 cut are the x and y components at broadside (theta_hat = x_hat, phi_hat = y_hat at phi = 0). tau_g = -d arg(H)/d omega from the unwrapped phase with central differences (one-sided at the ends). The excitation spectrum and its phase cancel; the NF2FF phase centre only adds a constant (z of the centre / c0 at broadside). The absolute value contains the constant electrical length of the line and of the stub; only the variation over the band (ripple) is meaningful. DIAGNOSTIC: not validated against a reference; 49.92 MHz spacing is below the DTFT resolution 1/T_record of the run, so adjacent samples are not independent.
far_field.cpu_note: CalcNF2FF uses numThreads=0 (all hardware threads) but the process runs under taskset <= 2 CPUs
assumptions: PML_8 thin absorber 4 mm (0.1 lambda0) next to the box (box 1 cell inside it, default derived by openEMS); box-to-board distance 17.5 mm = 0.47 lambda0 at f0
near-field box includes the finite 26x26 mm ground and substrate edge fields; no substrate/ground crosses the box faces
